summary: Exact PF ordinals k=32..49 are 18/18 terminally dispositioned. The range provides a failure-tested adaptive-learning lifecycle lineage spanning SOMA candidate training/deploy/rollback, LCME/Hippocampus maturity gating, feedback provenance, atomic runtime config and resource policy.

branch_feedback.action: Reuse the lifecycle pattern, not SOMA weights: Micro Visual Classifier candidate must remain shadow until held-out/open-set/forgetting/resource checks PASS, then atomically promote with exact last-known-good rollback.

Add cold-start/maturity state tests: deterministic visual baseline owns routing before learner maturity; learned component failure/rollback rescues to deterministic baseline without losing perception.

Add adaptation concurrency/crash tests: forced plus scheduled cycle admits one writer; config epoch and model/feature/schema version are receipted; crash yields complete old or new candidate, never hybrid.
Persist classifier/adaptation identity as weights/prototypes + schema/feature-backbone/config epoch + candidate/promoted/rollback state; reject incomplete-key or incompatible-version promotion.
Keep explicit user labels, trusted examples and proxy/click/engagement signals as separate provenance tiers; proxy score cannot silently become GOLD truth.
Regressionize NaN/Inf/zero-norm/empty-class/unknown-label metric cases; degenerate candidate-safety metrics fail closed rather than report zero drift/safe.
Measure resource duty cycle on target hardware; exceeding CPU/RAM/tail-latency budget pauses learner updates but must leave visual perception operational.
Learned retrieval/ranking stores selection evidence only; source records remain authoritative and deterministic fallback must remain available until maturity and after failures.

Express candidate lifecycle, atomic promotion, feature/schema version compatibility, resource budget and deterministic fallback as typed state/effect semantics without conflating learned confidence with authority.
